observations.evidence: a37a BSWAPs two8-byte input words, four16-byte key words and two output words: big endian. It starts sum0xe3779b90 (delta0x9e3779b9 times16 modulo2^32) and loops16 times. Each cycle subtracts the v0/key2,key3,sum mix fromv1, then subtracts v1/key0,key1,OLDsum mix fromv0, and reduces sum bydelta. The compiler updates sum before the v0 instruction but preserves oldsum+newv1 in a separate temporary. It is the exact16-cycle inverse of prior same-hash sign blocka2bc, not the same entry or a32-cycle replacement.

9cb0 saves incomingECX receiver then uses original offset64. Only when highDWORD0 and lowDWORD<=128 it handles min(length,128-low) bytes. For absolute x below128, keyByte=key[x%N]; product64=keyByte*(x+1); native unsigned64→double helpercbe0 is used, then SSE computes (uint32_hash / double(product64))*100.0 in DIV-then-MUL order. Helpercac0 converts that double to64 bits; remainder byN selects key mask. XOR output. Position128 processes0 prefix bytes and continues to segment path. Exact exceptional conversion/zero denominator is not covered by the nonzero-key v1 oracle.

After the prefix, allocateN-byte scratch. Compute q=unsigned64offset/5120. Process an initial partial segment to the next5120 boundary, then complete5120 segments, then final remainder. Position advancement uses ADD/ADC to retain64 bits. Each chunk invokes9b40 with receiver,scratch,offset64,buffer,length. Scratch is freed after the range.

observations.formula: 9b40 memcpy-copies allN initial state bytes fromstream+0x2c toscratch. q=offset64/5120; keyByte=key[qLow32&511] WITHOUT moduloN. product64=uint64(keyByte*(q+1)); native convert→SSE (hash/double(product64))*100→native integer64. skip=(convertedLow32&511)+(offsetLow32-qLow32*5120) modulo2^32; offset-within-segment is at most5119, so safe finite inputs skip at most5630. Starting i=j=0, discard skip steps; each step i=(i+1)%N,j=(j+S[i])%N,swap(S[i],S[j]). Then for each payload byte perform the same step and XOR S[(S[i]+S[j])%N]. N state entries contain8-bit values, not a standard256-entry permutation whenN>256.
